about: Muse-Glimmer-30B's raw outputs as the records hold them (text only, no token ids) and the answer ruleforge.judges.models._strip_muse_glimmer_thinking reads from each: the body of the last to=user message, whitespace stripped, or "" when no answer message opened or the framing cannot be read with certainty. tests/test_thinking_strippers.py holds the strip to every case; a reader of the raw outputs elsewhere can hold its own split to the same cases.

cases.text: to=self<|message|>Check each rule. Nothing applies.<|eom|><|start|>assistant to=user<|message|>no

cases.case: an answer with a trailer
cases.text: to=self<|message|>Rule 3 concerns privacy.<|eom|><|start|>assistant to=user<|message|>Final Judgment: yes
